verdict.rationale: Penpot documents personal access tokens that let an app, such as an agent, authenticate to Penpot's API, so it issues its own API credentials. Nothing in the evidence shows those tokens can be scoped, permission-limited, or restricted to least privilege. missing for 10: documented token scopes or permission granularity, per-agent or per-team restriction, read-only or limited-access token options, expiry or revocation controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Use access tokens as an alternative login authentication. They can allow an app to access Penpot's API.
